title: The Cold That Remembers
subtitle: A Saga of the Kept and the Spent
tagline: The cold remembers every life it has taken, and his is the one that came back.
cover_motif: A single banked coal cupped in an iron hand, its edges furred with frost: the emblem of the Kept Art, warmth that endures only because it was taken from something else. Gold on dark leather, the coal a small red wound in the cold.
genre_notes: Dark reincarnation isekai; slow magic, medicine, survival and war.
